newsitem.title: USA: Genentech gets FDA panel clearance.
newsitem.headline: Genentech gets FDA panel clearance.

text.p: Genentech Inc said Wednesday a U.S. Food and Drug Administration panel recommended for marketing clearance its drug Pulmozyme for patients in the advanced stages of cystic fibrosis.
The company said in a statement the Pulmonary Allergy Drug Advisory Committee to the FDA also recommended further study into the long term outcome of cystic fibrosis patients.

Pulmozyme, an aerosol treatment, is currently used for the management of mild to moderate cystic fibrosis in conjunction with standard therapies to reduce the incidence of respiratory tract infections requiring parenteral antibiotics and to improve pulmonary function.

Cystic fibrosis is an inherited disorder that affects about 25,000 Americans, 3,000 Canadians and 20,000 Europeans. A faulty gene in cystic fibrosis patients leads to the production of thick viscous secretions that can cause persistent bacterial infection and congestion which results in infections that damage lung tissue and ultimately lead to death.
